escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, INDIE CROSS EP3// SNEAK PEEK, by MORØ, with over 8 thousand comments.
In second place, How you invented blinds!, by Odd Tilt, with over 9 thousand comments.
And number one: GLITCH PRODUCTIONS ALL BOSSES (NO DAMAGE), by GLITCH, with over 11 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
